name: cinematic-scroll
title_zh: 滚动即运镜，一个组件把网页拍成电影
tagline_zh: 不做平平无奇的滚动页。章节钉住揭示、视差人像、悬停3D倾斜、背景随滚动换场——从单段到整站发布页。
tagline_en: No flat scroll. Pinned reveals, parallax figures, hover-tilt cards, morphing backdrops—from one section to a full.
desc_en: Build cinematic scroll-driven, 3D-tilt, parallax, and environment-morphing websites — pinned chapter reveals, hero parallax, depth-image figures, hover-tilt cards, background-morphing layouts, release/launch pages, product story pages, or editorial commerce microsites. From a single self-contained scroll section (Mode A) to a full Shopify-Editions-style Next.js release site with optional AI-genera
why_zh: 把滚动叙事拆成可组合的积木：每个效果独立成件，不绑架你的框架。给的是节奏感，不是模板套壳。
why_en: Scroll storytelling as composable primitives—each effect standalone, framework-agnostic. You get pacing, not a locked template.
limit_zh: 只出前端动效与结构，不含后端、CMS 或部署。AI 生成整站需 Next.js 环境。
limit_en: Front-end motion & structure only—no backend, CMS, or deploy. AI full-site mode needs Next.js; single-section mode needs your React app. Not for.
title_en: Scroll-driven cinematic web sections, one component
